# Release Notes - v1.0.1

## Changes

### User Management
- **Updated default user creation**: Changed from creating multiple default users to a single admin user

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed misleading log messages in user migration that didn't match actual user creation
- Simplified default user setup to create only one admin account instead of three users

### Migration Updates
- Updated `CreateDefaultUsers` migration to create single admin user
- Updated `CreateDefaultAdmin` service to match migration expectations

## Breaking Changes
- Default users `admin`, `devops`, and `user` are no longer created automatically
- Only one admin user `sourav` is created during initial setup
